project_type: Node.js runtime app with vanilla TS frontend (apps/ajun-runtime)
build_system: npm workspaces (14 packages), no bundler, tsc for frontend compile
test_framework: native node --test, test files in apps/ajun-runtime/test/*.test.js, import from ../public/*.js
build_command: npm run check (at repo root - includes tsc + architecture + frontend builds + TS ratio + any density)
test_command: npm test --workspace=ajun-runtime (runs pretest=check first then node --test)
verification_instructions: 1. npm run check at repo root, 2. npm test --workspace=ajun-runtime, 3. npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime && git diff --exit-code apps/ajun-runtime/public/ to verify no drift
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/*.js files are compiled from frontend/src/*.ts and checked into git. After changing any frontend/src/*.ts, must run npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime and commit the generated public/*.js files.
environment_constraints: No running services available (4321/4322 are not up). Tests mock dependencies. tsconfig: erasableSyntaxOnly true. public/*.js must stay tracked. Use html tagged template for frontend. Node >= 22.18.
contribution_requirements: Use html tagged template (auto-escaping) from frontend/src/html.ts for all new frontend rendering. raw() only for pre-sanitized HTML. Don't break existing 234 test files. New API endpoints follow pattern in runtime-http-handler.ts (router delegation functions). AI capability registration should persist to disk (dataDir pattern).
key_patterns: HTTP routes: delegated to routeXxxApi functions returning {status, payload} or null. Frontend: html`...` tagged template with escapeHtml auto-applied. Tests: node --test with describe/it/assert, import compiled JS from ../public/. Module policy: module-policy.json tracks file limits and affected tests. Capability store: CapabilityGrantStore pattern with disk persistence via JSON files.
directory_structure: Root: npm workspaces, apps/ajun-runtime is main product. apps/ajun-runtime/src/ has 279 .ts files (flat with prefix grouping). apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src/ has 20 .ts files compiled to public/*.js. apps/ajun-runtime/test/ has 234 test files. packages/ has shared modules. .github/workflows/ci.yml is CI.
